reviews.name: Peter Shu
reviews.text: I had their Hawaiian Shaved Ice at the MN State Fair Preview Weekend. It was unlike any snow cone I've ever had. I had a Passion Fruit and Guava, with Cream drizzled on top. Yep, best snow cone ever. Hands down. I hear they'll be at US Bank Stadium as well, and they'll serve them spiked there! Let's go!

reviews.name: Hayden J
reviews.text: Love this place! A must stop every time you see them in the summer! I love their staff! Best customer service to match the amazing cup of shave ice!
